info.title: Exalto Capture local administration API
info.description: Capture server administration API. Every /v1 route requires the configured HTTP Basic credentials, or a dashboard session started with them.

get.description: Returns the local service health and API version without requiring authentication.
Returns the exact OpenAPI 3.1 contract implemented by this local service.
Runs bounded metadata, selected artifact-writer, and shared trust dependency probes. Dependency outages or schema mismatches make readiness fail while /healthz remains local liveness.

Lists bounded, redacted Trace and service activity with opaque history pagination and a separate high-water cursor for following new items. Prompts, responses, credentials, headers, vault material, and decrypted capture content are never included.

Returns a safe read-only projection of the Registry pinned in shared metadata or the explicitly configured self-hosted endpoint and key. Registry membership describes allowed protocol use and does not report endpoint health.
Returns the current state, milestone progress, and complete attempt history for one durable operation.
Returns only captured's explicit provider adapters, their pinned upstream hosts, client API styles, proxy base URLs, and configured readiness.

post.description: Exchanges configured HTTP Basic credentials for an HttpOnly browser session cookie. Returns without a cookie when admin authentication is disabled.

delete.description: Deletes the current browser session and expires its local cookie.

get.description: Returns whether each newly completed, successful capture is queued for sealing.

put.description: Durably changes whether later captures are queued for sealing as they complete. Each seal uses the account's monthly notarization allowance, or the Free allowance under public access; a seal beyond it is refused, never billed. The cluster profile does not support auto-seal.

get.description: Returns the authoritative daemon-owned mode used when admitting new provider requests: `off` forwards directly and records nothing, `witnessed` sends the plaintext exchange to the notary, which signs a receipt, and `notarized` uses Proxy-TLS so the notary never receives plaintext or credentials.

put.description: Durably changes how later provider requests are admitted. Choosing `witnessed` or `notarized` first initializes trusted notary state; a failure leaves the previous mode in place.

get.description: Returns listener addresses, bounded metadata and artifact-writer readiness, vault and Notary configuration, preview limits, and current Trace counts.
Lists continuing Trace records in stable newest-first order with opaque cursor pagination and exact state, operational-status, provider, model, streaming, and date filters.
Returns one continuing Trace with capture facts, current state and operational status, retained evidence facts, and notarization attempt history.

delete.description: Idempotently removes one terminal Trace and its private local artifacts. Active capture or sealing must finish first. This action does not delete a separately retained hosted Trace.

204.description: Local Trace and owned artifacts deleted, or already absent

get.description: Returns the bounded manifest and canonical disclosed OpenTelemetry content from the retained package. It never returns the encrypted capture checkpoint or undisclosed request material.

post.description: Idempotently starts, resumes, or retries the Trace's one durable notarization operation and returns its technical polling location.

get.description: Returns the exact retained canonical .llmtrace bytes without conversion, regeneration, or transformation, with length and SHA-256 metadata and no-store caching.

post.description: Verifies the retained package evidence, disclosure, hashes, provider mapping, and canonical content against configured Notary trust. Local deletion waits until this retained-package read and verification finishes.
Verifies exactly one bounded .llmtrace body against a request-scoped key override or configured Notary trust. The package is never imported, retained, indexed, or shared.

parameters.name: x-notary-trusted-notary-key
parameters.description: Optional request-scoped compressed SEC1 Notary verification key in hexadecimal

high_water_cursor.description: Snapshot cursor for polling events committed after this response.

CaptureMode.description:
How the daemon admits new provider requests. This is the one durable
capture setting; each request snapshots it once.

EvidenceKind.description:
How a trace package's evidence was produced. This is a trust level, not a
state: a Notarized package carries a TLSNotary proof, a Witnessed package
carries the notary operator's signed receipt.

active_key_id.description:
Selected active Registry key. Explicit configuration has no Registry
lifecycle selection and therefore leaves this field unset.

registry_source.description: Public URL from which the current pinned Registry generation came.

source.description:
`registry` for the locally pinned trust store or
`explicit_configuration` for a self-hosted endpoint and key.

phase.description:
Current milestone: queued, preparing, proving, signing, packaging,
complete, or unknown for an operation migrated from an older metadata.

oneOf.description: Concrete work counters while the private proof is being generated.

evidence_kind.description:
How the trace was captured. A Sealed (`notarized` state) trace is
backed by a TLSNotary proof only when this is `notarized`; a
`witnessed` trace is sealed by the notary operator's signed receipt.

oneOf.description:
How the verified package's evidence was produced, read from its
manifest format. A `witnessed` package carries the notary operator's
signed receipt, not a cryptographic proof; only a `notarized` package
carries a TLSNotary proof. Absent when verification did not pass.
